name: podcast-studio-web
description: The public browser application for Wiplash Podcast Studio.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @wiplash/podcast-contracts && npm run build -w @wiplash/podcast-web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @wiplash/podcast-contracts && npm run dev -w @wiplash/podcast-web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @wiplash/podcast-contracts && npm run test -w @wiplash/podcast-contracts && npm run test -w @wiplash/podcast-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wiplash/podcast-contracts && npm run typecheck -w @wiplash/podcast-contracts && npm run typecheck -w @wiplash/podcast-web
scripts.verify: npm run boundary:check && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:responsive
